items.title: OTel feature gate: connector.spanmetrics.includeCollectorInstanceID · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.136.0. When enabled, connector add collector.instance.id to default dimensions.

items.title: OTel feature gate: connector.spanmetrics.legacyMetricNames · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.109.0. When enabled, connector uses legacy metric names.

items.title: OTel feature gate: connector.spanmetrics.useSecondAsDefaultMetricsUnit · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.137.0. When enabled, connector use second as default unit for duration metrics.

items.title: OTel feature gate: spanmetrics.statusCodeConvention.useOtelPrefix · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.141.0. When enabled, generated metrics will use `otel.status_code=ERROR` instead of `status.code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR`

items.title: OTel feature gate: connector.routing.defaultErrorModeIgnore · main
items.summary: STABLE gate; introduced v0.155.0. When enabled, the default error_mode is `ignore` instead of `propagate`. Stage transition/removal version: v0.166.0.

items.title: OTel feature gate: awsemf.nodimrollupdefault · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.83.0. Changes the default AWS EMF Exporter Dimension rollup option to NoDimensionRollup

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.awsemf.DisableLegacyResourceToTelemetryConversion · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, the deprecated enabled and exclude_service_attributes fields in resource_to_telemetry_conversion are disabled, and included/excluded patterns must be used instead

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.awsxray.DontEmitV0DBConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.147.0. When enabled, the AWS X-Ray exporter no longer reads deprecated semconv v1.12.0 database attribute keys. Requires exporter.awsxray.EmitV1DBConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.awsxray.DontEmitV0HTTPNetworkConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.147.0. When enabled, the AWS X-Ray exporter no longer reads deprecated semconv v1.12.0 HTTP and network attribute keys. Requires exporter.awsxray.EmitV1HTTPNetworkConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.awsxray.EmitV1DBConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.147.0. When enabled, the AWS X-Ray exporter reads database span attributes using semconv v1.38.0 keys (db.namespace, db.system.name, db.query.text, user.name) instead of the deprecated v1.12.0 keys (db.name, db.system, db.statement, db.user).

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.awsxray.EmitV1HTTPNetworkConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.163.0. When enabled, the AWS X-Ray exporter reads HTTP and network span attributes using semconv v1.38.0 keys (e.g. http.request.method, server.address, server.port, client.address, messaging.message.body.size) instead of the deprecated v1.12.0 keys.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.awsxray.skiptimestampvalidation · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.84.0. Remove XRay's timestamp validation on first 32 bits of trace ID

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.xray.allowDot · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.97.0. X-Ray Exporter will no longer convert . to _ in annotation keys when this feature gate is enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.DisableAPMStats · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.89.0. Datadog Exporter will not compute APM Stats

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.TraceExportUseCustomHTTPClient · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.105.0. When enabled, trace export uses the HTTP client from the exporter HTTP configs

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.metricexportserializerclient · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.122.0. When enabled, metric export in datadogexporter uses the serializer exporter from the Datadog Agent.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.file.nativeCompression · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.154.0. Use native file-level compression (zstd) instead of message-level compression. Creates standard .zst files compatible with standard decompression tools

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.googlecloud.CustomMonitoredResources · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.122.0. When enabled, the googlecloudexporter will map the OTLP metrics to the monitored resource type defined by the resource label gcp.resource_type. The MR labels are defined by resource labels with the prefix gcp.<monitored_resource_type>.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.kafka.useRequestType · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.157.0. When enabled, the Kafka exporter converts pdata into Kafka records at request-creation time and uses a custom exporterhelper.Request for queue/batch sizing.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheus.DisableResourceToTelemetryConversion · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, the deprecated resource_to_telemetry_conversion section and legacy conversion fields are disabled, and resource_constant_labels must be used instead

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheusexporter.DisableAddMetricSuffixes · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.132.0. When enabled, the deprecated add_metric_suffixes configuration option is ignored and translation_strategy is always used

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheusremotewrite.DisableResourceToTelemetryConversion · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, the deprecated resource_to_telemetry_conversion section and legacy conversion fields are disabled, and resource_constant_labels must be used instead

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheusremotewritexporter.EnableMultipleWorkers · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.118.0. When enabled and settings configured, the Prometheus remote exporter will spawn multiple workers/goroutines to handle incoming metrics batches concurrently.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheusremotewritexporter.RetryOn429 · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.101.0. When enabled, the Prometheus remote write exporter will retry 429 http status code. Requires exporter.prometheusremotewritexporter.metrics.RetryOn429 to be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheusremotewritexporter.enableSendingRW2 · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.125.0. When enabled, the Prometheus remote write exporter will support sending rw2. Extra configuration is still required besides enabling this feature gate.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.prometheusremotewritexporter.removeTopLevelHTTPSettings · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, it rejects top-level HTTP client settings (e.g. endpoint, tls, proxy_url); configure them under the http block instead.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.signalfx.consumeEntityEvents · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.145.0. Process entity events from logs pipeline and convert to dimension property updates

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.awslogsencoding.cloudtrail.enable.user.identity.prefix · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.145.0. When enabled, CloudTrail log userIdentity attributes will use 'aws.user_identity' prefix. This helps to preserve the attribute origin.

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.awslogsencoding.vpcflow.start.iso8601 · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.138.0. When enabled, aws.vpc.flow.start field will be formatted as ISO-8601 string instead of seconds since epoch integer.

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.encoding.awslogsencoding.DontEmitV0RPCConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.150.0. When enabled, CloudTrail log unmarshaler no longer emits the deprecated semconv v1.38.0 attributes rpc.service and rpc.system. Requires extension.encoding.awslogsencoding.EmitV1RPCConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.encoding.awslogsencoding.EmitV1RPCConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.150.0. When enabled, CloudTrail log unmarshaler emits rpc.system.name (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated rpc.system (semconv v1.38.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.azureencoding.DontEmitV0LogConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.149.0. When enabled, v0 semconv log attribute names are not emitted.

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.azureencoding.EmitV1LogConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.149.0. When enabled, v1 semconv log attribute names are emitted.

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.encoding.googlecloudlogentryencoding.DontEmitV0RPCConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, audit log parser no longer emits the deprecated semconv v1.38.0 attributes rpc.jsonrpc.error_code and rpc.jsonrpc.error_message.

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.healthcheck.useComponentStatus · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.142.0. Switch to the shared healthcheck implementation powered by component status events

items.title: OTel feature gate: extension.opampextension.RemoteRestarts · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.145.0. When enabled, the OpAMP extension supports restart commands from the OpAMP server through the `CommandType_Restart` command.

items.title: OTel feature gate: datadog.EnableOperationAndResourceNameV2 · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.118.0. When enabled, datadogexporter and datadogconnector use improved logic to compute operation name and resource name.

items.title: OTel feature gate: datadog.EnableReceiveResourceSpansV2 · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.118.0. When enabled, use a refactored implementation of the span receiver which improves performance by 10% and deprecates some not-to-spec functionality.

items.title: OTel feature gate: datadog.EnableScopeConvention · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, use otel.scope.name and otel.scope.version convention to set scope name and version instead of the deprecated otel.library.name and otel.library.version.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.AddUnits · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.157.0. When enabled, the Datadog Exporter adds units to exported metrics.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.DisableAllMetricRemapping · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.146.0. When enabled the Datadog Exporter stops mapping OpenTelemetry semantic conventions to Datadog semantic conventions for all locally mapped conventions including system and runtime metrics.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.EnableAttributeSliceMultiTagExporting · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.142.0. When enabled, attributes with slice values will have their elements turned into individual `key:value` Datadog tags.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.InferIntervalForDeltaMetrics · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.148.0. When enabled, the exporter will infer the metrics interval for OTLP delta sums using a heuristic.

items.title: OTel feature gate: exporter.datadogexporter.metricremappingdisabled · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.110.0. When enabled the Datadog Exporter stops mapping OpenTelemetry semantic conventions to Datadog semantic conventions. This feature gate is only for internal use. [DEPRECATED] Use 'exporter.datadogexporter.DisableAllMetricRemapping' instead.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.experimentalmetricmetadata.useEntityEventsSpecification · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.156.0. When enabled, emit entity events using the OpenTelemetry entity events specification log record format.

items.title: OTel feature gate: ottl.functions.enableLambda · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.155.0. Allow OTTL functions to take lambda arguments. When disabled, lambda arguments are rejected.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.ottl.enableDynamicMapKeys · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.164.0. Allow map literal keys to be paths or converters that resolve to a string at runtime. When disabled, map literal keys must be string literals.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.ottl.functions.enableDynamicSliceArguments · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.163.0. Allow slice arguments of stable OTTL functions, such as the values of Concat, to be paths or converters that resolve to a slice at runtime. When disabled, these arguments only accept list literals.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.ottl.functions.enableExperimental · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.163.0. Allow OTTL statements and conditions to use experimental functions. When disabled, experimental functions are rejected.

items.title: OTel feature gate: logs.assignKeys · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.93.0. When enabled, allows usage of `assign_keys` transformer.

items.title: OTel feature gate: logs.jsonParserArray · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.93.0. When enabled, allows usage of `json_array_parser`.

items.title: OTel feature gate: parser.uri.ecscompliant · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.103.0. When enabled resulting map will be in semconv compliant format.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.stanza.addDefaultScopeName · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.162.0. When enabled, adds a default scope name and version for stanza log entries without scope name

items.title: OTel feature gate: stanza.synchronousLogEmitter · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.122.0. Prevents possible data loss in Stanza-based receivers by emitting logs synchronously.

items.title: OTel feature gate: stanza.udp.useStableNetworkAttributes · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, the udp_input operator's `add_attributes` option emits stable network semantic convention attributes (network.transport, network.local.address, server.port, server.address, network.peer.address, client.port, client.address) instead of the deprecated ones (net.transport, net.host.ip, net.host.port, net.host.name, net.peer.ip, net.peer.port, net.peer.name).

items.title: OTel feature gate: stanza.windows.eventDrivenScraping · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.148.0. When enabled, the Stanza windows input wakes on API signals instead of polling on a fixed interval.

items.title: OTel feature gate: filelog.allowFileDeletion · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.70.0. When enabled, allows usage of the `delete_after_read` setting.

items.title: OTel feature gate: filelog.allowHeaderMetadataParsing · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.73.0. When enabled, allows usage of the `header` setting.

items.title: OTel feature gate: filelog.mtimeSortType · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.89.0. When enabled, allows usage of `ordering_criteria.mode` = `mtime`.

items.title: OTel feature gate: filelog.requireExplicitTopN · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, requires `ordering_criteria.top_n` to be set explicitly when `ordering_criteria.sort_by` is configured. When disabled, an unset `top_n` falls back to the legacy default of 1.

items.title: OTel feature gate: filelog.windows.caseInsensitive · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.142.0. On Windows, make matching patterns in include/exclude case insensitive.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.faro.DontEmitV0DeploymentEnvironmentConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.155.0. When enabled, the Faro translator no longer emits the deprecated deployment.environment attribute (semconv v1.26.0). Requires pkg.translator.faro.EmitV1DeploymentEnvironmentConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.faro.EmitV1DeploymentEnvironmentConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.155.0. When enabled, the Faro translator emits deployment.environment.name (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated deployment.environment (semconv v1.26.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.azurelogs.DontEmitV0LogConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.147.0. When enabled, the deprecated semconv attributes code.function and code.filepath are not emitted. Requires pkg.translator.azurelogs.EmitV1LogConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.azurelogs.EmitV1LogConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.147.0. When enabled, the stable semconv attributes code.function.name and code.file.path are emitted.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.prometheus.KeepIdentifyingResourceAttributes · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. Preserve service.name, service.namespace, and service.instance.id as labels on target_info in addition to job and instance.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.prometheus.CorrectUCUMUnits · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. Use spec-compliant UCUM unit mappings.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.prometheus.PermissiveLabelSanitization · main
items.summary: STABLE gate; introduced v0.55.0. Controls whether to change labels starting with '_' to 'key_'. Stage transition/removal version: v0.166.0.

items.title: OTel feature gate: translator.skywalking.useStableSemconv · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.146.0. When enabled, uses stable semantic conventions (v1.38.0) for attribute names (e.g., url.full, http.response.status_code, db.namespace, server.address). When disabled, uses legacy attribute names (e.g., http.url, http.status_code, db.name, net.peer.name).

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.DontEmitV0CloudResourceConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.155.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator no longer emits the deprecated faas.id attribute (semconv v1.18.0). Requires pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1CloudResourceConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.DontEmitV0HttpConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator no longer emits the deprecated http.status_code attribute (semconv v1.25.0). Requires pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1HttpConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.DontEmitV0NetworkConventions · main

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.DontEmitV0ScopeConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator no longer emits the deprecated otel.library.name and otel.library.version attributes (semconv v1.25.0). Requires pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1ScopeConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1CloudResourceConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.155.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator emits cloud.resource_id (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated faas.id (semconv v1.18.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1HttpConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator emits http.response.status_code (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated http.status_code (semconv v1.25.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1NetworkConventions · main
items.summary: STABLE gate; introduced v0.147.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator emits network.local.address and network.peer.address and service.peer.name (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated net.host.ip, net.peer.ip, and peer.service (semconv v1.12.0). items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1ScopeConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, the Zipkin translator emits otel.scope.name and otel.scope.version (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated otel.library.name and otel.library.version (semconv v1.25.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.jaeger.DontEmitV0HttpConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, the Jaeger translator no longer emits the deprecated http.status_code attribute (semconv v1.25.0). Requires pkg.translator.jaeger.EmitV1HttpConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: pkg.translator.jaeger.EmitV1HttpConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, the Jaeger translator emits http.response.status_code (semconv v1.40.0) instead of the deprecated http.status_code (semconv v1.25.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.k8sattributes.DontEmitV0K8sConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.145.0. When enabled, semconv legacy attributes are disabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.k8sattributes.EmitV1K8sConventions · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.145.0. When enabled, semconv stable attributes are enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.k8sattributes.EnableKubeletPodSource · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.164.0. When enabled, k8sattributesprocessor can use kubelet /pods polling as the pod metadata source.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.k8sattributes.ShareProcessorBetweenPipelines · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.150.0. When enabled, processor instances with identical configuration are shared across different signal type pipelines, reducing duplicate Kubernetes API watchers.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.k8sattributes.telemetry.disableOldFormatMetrics · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.146.0. When enabled, old formatted internal telemetry metrics are disabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.k8sattributes.telemetry.enableNewFormatMetrics · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.146.0. When enabled, new formatted internal telemetry metrics are enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: metricsgeneration.MatchAttributes · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.112.0. When enabled, the metric calculations will only be done between data points whose attributes match.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.resourcedetection.elasticbeanstalk.DontEmitV0DeploymentConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, the detector no longer emits the deprecated deployment.environment and service.instance.id resource attributes. Requires processor.resourcedetection.elasticbeanstalk.EmitV1DeploymentConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.resourcedetection.elasticbeanstalk.EmitV1DeploymentConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, the detector emits deployment.environment.name and deployment.id instead of the deprecated deployment.environment and service.instance.id.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.azuredetector.RenameResourceGroupAttribute · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. When enabled, the azure detector emits the azure.resource_group.name resource attribute instead of azure.resourcegroup.name, aligning with semantic convention naming.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.resourcedetection.consul.prefixMetaAttributes · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, Consul node metadata is emitted as `consul.meta.<key>` resource attributes instead of `<key>`.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.resourcedetection.openshift.removeCloudNameRegion · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. When enabled, the detector no longer sets `cloud.region` from the Azure or OpenStack `cloudName`, which names a cloud environment or a `clouds.yaml` entry rather than a region.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.tailsamplingprocessor.metricstatcountbytessampled · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.152.0. When enabled, a new metric stat_count_bytes_sampled will be available in the tail sampling processor. Differently from stat_count_traces_sampled, this metric will count the number of bytes sampled or not per sampling policy, where the original counts traces.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.tailsamplingprocessor.metricstatcountspanssampled · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.95.0. When enabled, a new metric stat_count_spans_sampled will be available in the tail sampling processor. Differently from stat_count_traces_sampled, this metric will count the number of spans sampled or not per sampling policy, where the original counts traces.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.tailsamplingprocessor.recordpolicy · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.120.0. When enabled, attaches the name of the policy (and if applicable, composite policy) responsible for sampling a trace in the 'tailsampling.policy', 'tailsampling.composite_policy', and `tailsampling.cached_decision` attributes.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.tailsamplingprocessor.tailstorageextension · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.150.0. When enabled, allows configuring tail_storage to use a tail storage extension implementation.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.tailsamplingprocessor.usetracestate · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, sampling policies consult OpenTelemetry probability sampling information carried in W3C tracestate (the 'rv' and 'th' fields of the 'ot' section). The 'probabilistic' policy uses tracestate randomness for its sampling decision (falling back to the legacy FNV trace ID hash when no tracestate sampling info is present), and the processor rewrites the outgoing 'th' on sampled traces to the effective threshold across all matched policies.

items.title: OTel feature gate: processor.transform.enableExperimentalFunctions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. Allow the transform processor's experimental functions to be used in statements and conditions. When disabled, experimental functions are rejected.

items.title: OTel feature gate: transform.flatten.logs · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.103.0. Flatten log data prior to transformation so every record has a unique copy of the resource and scope. Regroups logs based on resource and scope after transformations.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.apache.disableOldFormatMetrics · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, the receiver no longer emits the original metric and attribute names (e.g. apache.requests, apache.scoreboard, and the mode/level/state attributes). Requires receiver.apache.enableNewFormatMetrics to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.apache.enableNewFormatMetrics · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, the receiver emits the new, consistently named metrics and attributes (e.g. apache.request.count, apache.worker.status, cpu.mode) alongside the original ones. See the migration guide linked from the component README for the full mapping.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.awscontainerinsightreceiver.useNewTypeName · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.143.0. When enabled, the receiver uses the new component type name 'awscontainerinsight' instead of 'awscontainerinsightreceiver'.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.awsxray.DontEmitV0HttpConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, semconv legacy HTTP attributes are disabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.awsxray.EmitV1HttpConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, semconv stable HTTP attributes are enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.awsecscontainermetrics.DontEmitV0ContainerConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.157.0. When enabled, the receiver no longer emits the deprecated semconv v1.21.0 attribute container.image.tag. Requires receiver.awsecscontainermetrics.EmitV1ContainerConventions to also be enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.awsecscontainermetrics.EmitV1ContainerConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.157.0. When enabled, the receiver emits container.image.tags (semconv v1.42.0) instead of the deprecated container.image.tag (semconv v1.21.0).

items.title: OTel feature gate: cloudfoundry.resourceAttributes.allow · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.117.0. When enabled, envelope tags are copied to the metrics as resource attributes instead of datapoint attributes

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.datadogreceiver.DontEmitDeprecatedRPCServiceAttr · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.154.0. When enabled, the receiver no longer emits the deprecated rpc.service attribute on gRPC spans or resource attributes. The service name is already captured in the span name (service/method) and rpc.method.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.datadogreceiver.Enable128BitTraceID · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.125.0. When enabled, reconstructs full 128-bit TraceIDs for spans coming from Datadog instrumented services so they correlate with OpenTelemetry spans. Enabled by default; disable to fall back to 64-bit (zero-padded) TraceIDs.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.datadogreceiver.EnableMultiTagParsing · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.142.0. When enabled, parses `key:value` tags with duplicate keys into a slice attribute.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.githubreceiver.UseCheckRunID · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.151.0. When enabled, deterministic job, step, and queue span IDs are derived from the GitHub check_run_id (the WorkflowJob.id webhook field, also exposed in-runner as ${{ job.check_run_id }}). Step span IDs additionally incorporate the step's raw name, allowing in-action telemetry tools to reproduce matching span IDs without calling the GitHub REST API and without knowing the runner-dependent step number. Payloads missing a check_run_id are rejected while this gate is enabled. Workflows with duplicate step names within a job will log a warning; duplicate steps will share the same span ID.

items.title: OTel feature gate: scraper.process.DontEmitV0SystemConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, semconv legacy attributes are disabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: scraper.process.EmitV1SystemConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, semconv stable attributes are enabled.

items.title: OTel feature gate: hostmetrics.process.bootTimeCache · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.98.0. When enabled, all process scrapes will use the boot time value that is cached at the start of the process.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.hostmetrics.DontEmitV0SystemConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, all scrapers stop emitting legacy semantic convention metrics, superseding per-scraper gates.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.hostmetrics.EmitV1SystemConventions · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, all scrapers emit metrics aligned with the latest semantic conventions, superseding per-scraper gates.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.hostmetricsreceiver.UseLinuxMemAvailable · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.137.0. When enabled, the used value for the system.memory.usage and system.memory.utilization metrics will be based on the Linux kernel's MemAvailable statistic instead of MemFree, Buffers, and Cached.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.k8sobjects.useInformerObserver · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.164.0. When enabled, the receiver collects objects via a shared informer factory (List+Watch backed by an in-memory cache) instead of the legacy per-object pull/watch observers. Pull mode reads from the informer cache; watch mode uses informer event handlers with automatic relist/reconnect. The `pull` RBAC now also requires the `watch` verb, `resource_version` is ignored, and `exclude_watch_type: [BOOKMARK, ERROR]` is a no-op.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.kubeletstats.cpuUsageScrapeBased · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.156.0. When enabled, container.cpu.usage, k8s.pod.cpu.usage and k8s.node.cpu.usage (and the cpu utilization metrics derived from them) are calculated by the receiver as the rate of the corresponding *.cpu.time counter between consecutive scrapes, instead of being read directly from the kubelet's UsageNanoCores value.

items.title: OTel feature gate: postgresqlreceiver.preciselagmetrics · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.89.0. Metric `postgresql.wal.lag` is replaced by more precise `postgresql.wal.delay`.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.postgresql.connectionPool · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.96.0. Use of connection pooling

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.postgresql.separateSchemaAttr · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.122.0. Moves Schema Names into dedicated Attribute

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.postgresql.useOTelSemconv · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.156.0. When enabled, uses a single resource per server with a service.instance.id (UUID v5) resource attribute, aligning with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions. When disabled, uses the legacy per-entity resource model with postgresql.database.name, postgresql.table.name, postgresql.index.name, and postgresql.schema.name resource attributes.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.prometheus.UseTargetUrlForServerAddress · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. When enabled, server.address, server.port, and url.scheme are populated from the scraped target's post-relabeling __address__ and __scheme__ labels instead of parsing the instance label and pre-relabeling service discovery labels.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.prometheusreceiver.EnableCreatedTimestampZeroIngestion · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.113.0. Enables the Prometheus created-timestamps-zero-injection feature. Created timestamps are injected as 0-valued samples when appropriate. This is disabled by default due to worse CPU performance with higher metric volumes.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.prometheus_remote_write.disableJobSplit · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. When enabled, the prometheusremotewritereceiver will disable the splitting of the job label by '/' to derive service.namespace and service.name, instead mapping the entire job string to service.name.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.statsd.monotonicCounterDefault · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, changes the default value of is_monotonic_counter to true, so that statsd counters are treated as monotonic sums by default. Explicitly setting is_monotonic_counter in the receiver config always takes precedence over this feature gate.

items.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.vcenter.resourcePoolMemoryUsageAttribute · main
items.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.105.0. Enables the memory usage type attribute for the vcenter.resource_pool.memory.usage metric

items.title: OTel feature gate: domainControllers.autodiscovery · main
items.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.150.0. When enabled and is remote automatically discover domain controllers through joined controllers and  start collecting logs from specified channel.
